name: UserAccessProfile
description: Private server-maintained transcription access lifecycle record for one user account

owner_email.description: Verified account email that owns this access record

lifecycle_status.description: TRIALING, TRIAL_EXPIRED, PAYMENT_PENDING, PREMIUM_ACTIVE, PREMIUM_EXPIRED, or ADMIN_RESTRICTED

trial_end.description: Free-trial expiration timestamp, exactly 7 days after trial_start

premium_payment_id.description: Approved payment record that granted the current Premium period

premium_payment_method.description: Payment method for the current Premium period

manual_restricted_at.description: When the manual restriction was applied

manual_restricted_by.description: Private administrator actor reference for the manual restriction

internal_note.description: Private administrator-only note about the account

pending_payment_id.description: Most recent pending payment record id

pending_payment_submitted_at.description: Submission timestamp for the pending payment

first_activity_at.description: First authenticated activity timestamp observed by the server

last_activity_at.description: Most recent authenticated activity timestamp observed by the server

first_ip.description: First trusted request IP available to the server

last_ip.description: Most recent trusted request IP available to the server

last_lifecycle_transition_at.description: Timestamp of the last lifecycle transition audit

last_lifecycle_transition_key.description: Idempotency key for the last lifecycle transition audit

signup_notification_status.description: Server-controlled signup email marker: NOT_ATTEMPTED, SENDING, SENT, FAILED, or SKIPPED

signup_notification_at.description: Server timestamp when the signup email attempt completed

signup_notification_error.description: Safe bounded signup email delivery status detail
